patch_description: Choose placements using the KVPR after adding each model, rather than the GPU's current KVPR. This directly optimizes the stated objective at every assignment and accounts for both the new request pressure and reduced remaining memory. Models are ordered by pressure and size so difficult models are placed first. A small improvement pass then moves models away from the current bottleneck GPU whenever doing so strictly lowers the global maximum KVPR while preserving memory feasibility.
